message.shopcore.agriculture_daily.fille: Local news: %s
A chicken has been elected mayor of a nearby village.
The weather office predicts a 100% chance of weather.
A farmer reports that watering crops does, in fact, help them grow.
The annual potato-stacking contest ended in a tie.
A wandering trader insists his prices are already a bargain.
Experts recommend keeping dirt away from freshly washed vegetables.
The village office opened a second window for questions about why the first window is closed.
A meeting on reducing meetings was extended to cover next week's meeting.
The harvest report was praised for having no unapproved information.
A new sign reminds residents that reading signs is voluntary but strongly encouraged.
The seed ledger now requires three signatures to confirm that seeds exist.
The town clock was declared accurate after being adjusted to match itself.
A committee will study whether the committee needs a smaller committee.
The granary passed inspection after inspectors confirmed the inspection forms were stored safely.
Residents are asked not to feed the pigeons until the pigeons complete their registration.
The road repair notice has been repaired and is now easier to read than the road.
A farmer received an award for growing the most paperwork per acre.
The village market introduced a queue for joining the queue.
The lost-and-found is looking for the form that records lost forms.
An official assured everyone that the shortage of assurances is being monitored.
The public well will remain open except during scheduled water-saving water breaks.
The seasonal forecast predicts that seasons will arrive in their usual order.
A new stamp was issued to certify that older stamps remain valid.
The village newsletter won an award for reporting that it had won an award.
The price board was moved indoors to protect it from people checking prices.
Officials confirm that the emergency bell is only to be rung in approved emergencies.
A new fence was installed around the sign explaining why fences are unnecessary.
The village archive has archived its plan to organize the archive.
The annual efficiency survey now takes two days longer to complete.
The council approved a pilot program to test whether pilots need approval.
